_meta.purpose: Worldwide country/language/currency rules for aesthetic clinic price discovery
principles: Official currency is context, not a hard validation rule.
The extractor must recognize any supported global currency.
Common price currencies are practical search/extraction hints, not claims of legal tender.
Never reject a clinic-owned price solely because it is in EUR/USD/GBP or another recognized currency.
Search currency hints are intentionally capped to keep foreground search fast.
Use local-language search only when needed; do not fan out all languages and currencies on every request.
common_price_currencies are discovery hints for private/medical pricing and must not be interpreted as official legal tender.
recommended_search_order: Exa semantic rescue if still insufficient
